controls.name: tbDesc
controls.toolTip: Enter the Description. Press F2 or Double Click for Help.
controls.usage: Stores Description. Tag stores Code (primary key).

dataBindings.query: Select Code,description, Status from TERMSMASTER where typeflg = cmbTerms and Branchid=gBranchID and Compid=gCompID

databaseOperations.description: Auto-generates the next sequential Code for the selected Term.

databaseOperations.whereConditions: typeflg = cmbTerms and Description = tbDesc and Branchid=gBranchID and Compid=gCompID

databaseOperations.description: Check if record exists for update or insert
databaseOperations.whereConditions: typeflg = cmbTerms and Code = tbDesc.Tag and Branchid=gBranchID and Compid=gCompID

businessRules.name: Auto Code Generation
businessRules.description: When a term type is selected from cmbTerms, tbDesc.Tag (the underlying Code) is auto-populated with Max(Code) + 1 for that TypeFlg.

businessRules.name: Validation
businessRules.description: Description cannot be empty. Duplicate descriptions under the same TypeFlg, Branch, and Company are not allowed.

businessRules.name: Casing
businessRules.description: tbDesc is converted to uppercase on KeyPress.
